verdict.rationale: Metorial has a live public REST API and an OpenAPI spec, but nothing in the evidence shows API versioning (versioned endpoints or headers) or a documented deprecation policy. The only versioning evidence is pinning a provider deployment to a specific version, which is a related feature for provider deployments, not API versioning, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
